email.subject: Re: Reaction delivery bundling, from 17 October
email.body:
You said today: "we route every reaction through one bundle per run per person, not one message per skill — a person should get one thing to read, not four."

So now the work is settled in one direction. Reaction skills stop sending on their own as each one finishes. Everything a person gets from a run arrives together at the run's close, and anything that misses the close is held for the following run. Per-skill delivery is off the table.

That suggests to me that the reaction-delivery doc, which still says each skill sends its own message as it finishes, no longer describes what we'll build against. I read that as the close of a run becoming the clock everything else waits on. If that holds, anything that has to reach someone within a run now depends on the run closing first, and my read is that the batching window Tina questioned is still the open piece.

Does a skill that misses the close belong on the next run, or should some of them still go out alone? Is the reaction-delivery doc going to be rewritten around the bundle, or is that separate work? Did Tina's objection to the batching window get settled anywhere beyond this session?
